meta.title: dotnet skills
meta.description: Project-scoped .NET skills: the catalog is a superset of the official dotnet/skills collection (203 skills, all 108 official ones included), the current model picks from it using facts read from the project, the selection is copied into <project>/.dsh/Skills/DotnetSkills and .dsh/skills and refreshed when the catalog updates, and the Microsoft Learn MCP server can be switched on per working directory. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
